Bengal CM Blames Past Governments for Healthcare Infrastructure Issues

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee stated that the state's healthcare infrastructure is facing consequences due to the neglect by previous governments. She attributed current challenges to historical underdevelopment and lack of investment in the sector. This statement comes amidst ongoing discussions about public health services in the region.
